category_edits.rationale: Reduce the initial learning rate by 25% for all four categories to test whether smaller updates improve validation HR@10. Preserve the optimizer, scheduler configuration, batch size, dropout, weight decay, stopping policy, GRU architecture, loss, and predictor.

change_summary: Multiply the incumbent learning rate by 0.75 across all four category models; retain the existing 200-epoch cap and all other behavior.
